definitions.gloss: arts and crafts; art and handicrafts
definitions.explanation: A subject taught in Japanese elementary schools covering drawing, painting, sculpting, and making crafts. Short for {図画工作|ずがこうさく} (drawing and handicrafts).

examples.japanese: {図工|ずこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だった。
examples.english: I liked arts and crafts class.

examples.japanese: {図工|ずこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{粘土|ねんど}→粘土：19435_nendo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: We made clay works in arts and crafts class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{図工|ずこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水彩画|すいさいが}→水彩画：07077_suisaiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
Abbreviation of ⟦{図画工作|ずがこうさく}→図画工作：25294_zugakousaku⟧. Taught in Japanese elementary schools (grades 1–6), covering a broad range of creative activities including drawing, painting, clay work, woodworking, and paper crafts. In junior high school, the subject name changes to ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧ (fine arts) and ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (technology/crafts).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {図工|ずこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: arts and crafts period/class
- {図工|ずこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: arts and crafts lesson
- {図工|ずこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: artwork from arts and crafts

- ⟦{図画工作|ずがこうさく}→図画工作：25294_zugakousaku⟧: drawing and handicrafts — the full, formal name
- ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧: fine arts — the equivalent subject in junior high and high school
- ⟦{工作|こうさく}→工作：12437_kousaku⟧: handicrafts, crafting — the making/building component
